name: ALU FACTORY and OS Store
install:
set -euo pipefail
script=""
for c in "$PWD" "$PWD/ALU-CLAUDE" "$PWD/repos/ALU-CLAUDE" /workspace/ALU-CLAUDE /workspace/repos/ALU-CLAUDE /agent/ALU-CLAUDE /agent/repos/ALU-CLAUDE; do
  if [ -f "$c/.cursor/install.sh" ]; then
    script="$c/.cursor/install.sh"
    break
  fi
done
if [ -z "$script" ]; then
  script="$(find "$PWD" /workspace /agent -maxdepth 4 -type f -path '*/.cursor/install.sh' -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true)"
fi
if [ -z "$script" ]; then
  echo "Could not find .cursor/install.sh" >&2
  exit 1
fi
bash "$script"
start:
set -euo pipefail
script=""
for c in "$PWD" "$PWD/ALU-CLAUDE" "$PWD/repos/ALU-CLAUDE" /workspace/ALU-CLAUDE /workspace/repos/ALU-CLAUDE /agent/ALU-CLAUDE /agent/repos/ALU-CLAUDE; do
  if [ -f "$c/.cursor/start.sh" ]; then
    script="$c/.cursor/start.sh"
    break
  fi
done
if [ -z "$script" ]; then
  script="$(find "$PWD" /workspace /agent -maxdepth 4 -type f -path '*/.cursor/start.sh' -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true)"
fi
if [ -z "$script" ]; then
  echo "Could not find .cursor/start.sh" >&2
  exit 1
fi
bash "$script"
